treasure1.name: Credit
treasure1.image_alt: A single slim credit chip with copper contacts and a luminous cyan inset.

treasure2.name: Battery
treasure2.image_alt: A tall illuminated energy battery secured inside a copper and blue cradle.

treasure3.name: Reactor
treasure3.image_alt: A suspended fusion reactor core surrounded by three bright containment hoops.

victory1.name: Outpost
victory1.description: Worth 1 point at the end of the game.
victory1.image_alt: A single landing outpost with a warm window and antenna on a quiet moon.

victory2.name: Habitat
victory2.description: Worth 3 points at the end of the game.
victory2.image_alt: A circular orbital habitat with windowed living quarters and a green central garden.

victory3.name: Worldship
victory3.description: Worth 6 points at the end of the game.
victory3.image_alt: An immense worldship carrying domed cities between long blue solar outriggers.

curse.name: Debris
curse.description: Worth minus 1 point at the end of the game.
curse.image_alt: Jagged satellite wreckage, a cracked panel and loose cables drifting in a debris cloud.

k01.name: Fabricator
k01.description: Take a card costing up to 5 into your hand. Then put a card from your hand on top of your deck.
k01.image_alt: A robotic fabrication gantry printing a coral module in a pool of cyan light.

k02.name: Corsair
k02.description: Take a Reactor. Each opponent reveals their top 2 cards, scraps a revealed Treasure other than Credit if possible, and discards the rest.
k02.image_alt: A violet corsair ship with swept fins and a glowing stolen cargo pod.

k03.name: Quartermaster
k03.description: Take a Battery onto your deck. Each opponent puts a Victory card from their hand onto their deck, or reveals a hand without any.
k03.image_alt: A quartermaster’s luminous inventory tablet beside three secured supply pods.

k04.name: Cargo Bay
k04.description: Gain 1 action. Discard as many cards as you choose, then draw that many cards.
k04.image_alt: An open spacecraft cargo bay with colorful containers beneath a lifting crane.

k05.name: Recycler
k05.description: Scrap up to 4 cards from your hand.
k05.image_alt: A turquoise recycling machine compressing loose metal into a neat orange block.

k06.name: Conclave
k06.description: Draw 4 cards and gain 1 buy. Every other player draws 1 card.
k06.image_alt: A circular council platform with six glowing seats around a holographic planet.

k07.name: Solstice
k07.image_alt: A brilliant sun and eclipsing planet aligned inside a gold orbital observance ring.

k08.name: Biosphere
k08.description: Worth 1 point for every complete group of 10 cards in your deck, counting all zones, at game end.
k08.image_alt: A transparent biosphere dome sheltering trees and water on a red moon.

k09.name: Pathfinder
k09.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. You may put a card from your discard pile onto your deck.
k09.image_alt: A six-wheeled exploration rover following a route between amber mountains.

k10.name: Observatory
k10.image_alt: A long orbital telescope with golden solar wings aimed toward a distant star.

k11.name: Data Vault
k11.description: Draw until your hand contains 7 cards. You may set aside Action cards drawn this way; discard them after drawing finishes.
k11.image_alt: A secure cylindrical data vault with luminous memory wafers and a hexagonal lock.

k12.name: Spaceport
k12.description: Draw 1 card; gain 1 action, 1 buy and 1 energy.
k12.image_alt: A spaceport landing pad and control tower welcoming a small descending shuttle.

k13.name: Trader
k13.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. The first Battery you play this turn provides 1 extra energy.
k13.image_alt: A floating trade kiosk displaying a glowing cargo cube between two docking hands.

k14.name: Interceptor
k14.description: Gain 2 energy. Every opponent discards until they have 3 cards in hand.
k14.image_alt: A sharp-winged interceptor accelerating with twin coral engine trails.

k15.name: Transmuter
k15.description: You may scrap a Treasure from your hand, then take a Treasure costing at most 3 more into your hand.
k15.image_alt: A matter transmuter turning a bronze block into a glowing faceted crystal.

k16.name: Shield Array
k16.description: Draw 2 cards. When an opponent attacks, you may reveal this from your hand to avoid that attack.
k16.image_alt: Three defense emitters holding a translucent shield over a small station.

k17.name: Salvager
k17.description: You may scrap a Credit from your hand to gain 3 energy.
k17.image_alt: A yellow salvage claw extracting a bright chip from a broken satellite.

k18.name: Scavenger
k18.description: Draw 1 card, gain 1 action and 1 energy. Discard 1 card for each empty supply pile.
k18.image_alt: A compact scavenging tug towing a net of scrap through an asteroid field.

k19.name: Retrofitter
k19.description: Scrap a card from your hand. Take a card costing at most 2 more into your discard pile.
k19.image_alt: An open spacecraft engine housing receiving a bright replacement module from a service arm.

k20.name: Sensor Grid
k20.description: Draw 1 card and gain 1 action. Inspect the top 2 cards of your deck. Scrap any, discard any, then return the rest in your chosen order.
k20.image_alt: A triangular sensor network connecting three dishes around a sweeping radar screen.

k21.name: Shipyard
k21.image_alt: An unfinished starship suspended between red construction gantries and welding lights.

k22.name: Echo Chamber
k22.description: You may choose an Action from your hand and play it twice.
k22.image_alt: Two violet resonance portals reflecting the same small glowing probe.

k23.name: Drone
k23.description: Gain 2 energy. Discard your top card; if it is an Action, you may play it.
k23.image_alt: A small inspection drone with four blue rotors, a camera eye and a delivery claw.

k24.name: Waypoint
k24.image_alt: A tall navigation beacon with three directional panels and a glowing route through space.

k25.name: Saboteur
k25.description: Draw 2 cards. Every opponent takes Debris, if any remain.
k25.image_alt: A breached control panel with cut glowing wires, a red warning light and a small wrench.

k26.name: Assembler
k26.description: Take a card costing up to 4 into your discard pile.
k26.image_alt: Two articulated assembly arms fitting a blue component on a moving production belt.
